lines.tts: This temple was broken five times.
And it's still standing.
Daksh married his twenty-seven daughters to the Moon. But the Moon loved only Rohini.
So Daksh cursed him. Waste away.

caps: The Moon came here, | to *PRABHASA*, by the sea…
lines.tts: The Moon came here, to Prabhas, by the sea... and chanted the मृत्युंजय mantra, for six months.
Shiva appeared. Wane for one fortnight... and grow back in the other.

caps: And Shiva *STAYED* here, | as *SOMNATH*: Lord of the Moon.
lines.tts: And Shiva stayed here, as Somnath. Lord of the Moon.

caps: Today's temple stands | in the old *MARU-GURJARA* style.
lines.tts: Today's temple stands in the old Maaru Gurjar style.

caps: And on its sea wall… | an *ARROW.*
lines.tts: And on its sea wall... an arrow.
Then the raiders came.
Ten twenty-six. Twelve ninety-nine. Thirteen ninety-five. Fourteen fifty-one. Seventeen oh six.
We won't say their names.

caps: But every time… | someone built it *BACK.*
lines.tts: But every time... someone built it back.
Moolraaj. Kumarpaal, in stone studded with jewels. Mahipaal.

caps: Beside the ruins, *AHILYABAI HOLKAR* | built a new Somnath.
lines.tts: Beside the ruins, Ahilyabai Holkar built a new Somnath.

caps: A widow at 28. | She lost her only *SON.*
Then she ruled Malwa | for *28 YEARS.*
lines.tts: A widow at twenty-eight. She lost her only son. Then she ruled Malwa for twenty-eight years.

caps: *RIVER GHATS.* Wells. Rest houses. | Free food for pilgrims.
lines.tts: River ghaats. Wells. Rest houses. Free food for pilgrims. From Badrinath to Rameswaram.
November, nineteen forty-seven. Sardar Patel came to Junagadh... and ordered: rebuild Somnath.

caps: The same year, he was joining | *500+* princely states
lines.tts: The same year, he was joining over five hundred princely states into one India.

caps: *GANDHI* said: let the *PEOPLE* | pay for it, not the state.
lines.tts: Gandhi said: let the people pay for it, not the state.

caps: *NEHRU* wrote that he did *NOT* like | the President going.
lines.tts: Nehru wrote that he did not like the President going. Rajendra Prasad went anyway.
Eleventh May, nineteen fifty-one. The लिंग was installed again.
Destroyed seventeen times? No.
Seventeen was his campaigns into India. Somnath was hit five times.

caps: Have you stood before *SOMNATH?* | Write *JAI SOMNATH.*
lines.tts: Have you stood before Somnath? Write, Jai Somnath.

caps: *NEXT:* the arrow that points | to the *SOUTH POLE.*
lines.tts: Next: the arrow that points to the South Pole.
